_comment: Copy to chat-report-verify.config.json and fill in UUIDs from your local claudecode store at $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects/<sanitized-cwd>/ (defaults to ~/.claude/projects/<sanitized-cwd>/ when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is unset). Use 'sessionJsonl' for an explicit path, or 'cwd' to let the script resolve the JSONL via the sanitization rule under the configured root.
